name: IDOL LIFE — Korean industry grounded event library
purpose: Codex integration content, not a plug-and-play engine: adapt phase IDs / flags to existing project
integration_order: Map existing career states and game data to this schema (no fabricated state)
Ambient eligibility filter + seeded weighted sampler + one-time occurrence memory
Control category/phase frequency and prevent adjacent near-duplicate notices
Support persistent NPC and song/project IDs for real continuity
Connect decision choices to state changes and later event eligibility; no fake effects
Schedule arcs with expected conditions; invalidate gracefully on phase change
State-derived monthly recaps + major milestone overlays
Run 100 seeded playthroughs and report phase coverage, duplicate rate and impossible events

generation_guidance.avoid_news_flood_at_x1: 1 year = 60 real seconds, so 1 month = 5 seconds; do not force displaying 5 separate animated cards in 5 seconds. Small routine changes can be logged compactly.
generation_guidance.selection: Eligibility -> remove already-seen events -> tag-based cooling -> weighted sampling -> semantic similarity dedup -> persist event outcomes
generation_guidance.one_time_and_lifecycle: Ambient events have one lifetime occurrence by default; add thematic variation only with real different state or NPC. Never loop on a small list.
generation_guidance.outcomes: Use seeded PRNG and meaningful state; do not guarantee positive results. Avoid retroactive rewrites of history.
generation_guidance.ethics: Health, crime, stalking, accidents are external risk; avoid portraying victims as deserving or causing harms.
generation_guidance.monthly_guarantee: If eligible pool small, generate truthful state-based monthly recaps; do not fabricate unseen events or emit unrelated lines.
